title: POC chief optimistic Team PH will surpass 4-gold target in Asiad
summary: Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) president Abraham "Bambol" Tolentino remains optimistic that Team Philippines can surpass its four-gold mark as the 20th Asian Games heads into its final three days.
